job.title: SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud and CX professional with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Specialized in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, and order management. Proven expertise bridging business requirements and technical execution through requirements analysis, user stories, and agile stakeholder management. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Amadeus Fire's reputation for delivering top-tier IT and business consulting solutions makes this SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant role an exciting opportunity. With over five years of specialized experience building and optimizing large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud & CX
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and storefront solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), managing complex product catalogs, pricing engines, and customer data.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Served as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, analyzing business requirements, authoring user stories and functional specifications, and mapping processes for seamless delivery.

bullets.label: Integrations & API Design
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST Web Services and engineered complex data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize PIM, ERP, and MDM systems across global channels.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Support
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, led database query refactoring to improve transaction speed, and supported user acceptance testing and production operations.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce and CX expertise aligns with Amadeus Fire.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at Amadeus Fire because of its established leadership in connecting top companies with expert IT and business talent, providing a dynamic environment where my SAP Commerce and CX consulting background will deliver immediate client value.
tailoring.motivation_short: Leveraging 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and strong techno-functional consulting skills to drive successful enterprise e-commerce projects at Amadeus Fire.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud and CX experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant role at Amadeus Fire. My CV and cover letter are attached—I look forward to connecting!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Commerce Cloud & SAP CX Consultant position at Amadeus Fire. With over five years of hands-on experience across SAP Commerce Cloud, OCC APIs, PIM/ERP integrations, and techno-functional analysis at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-prepared to contribute effectively to your projects. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to speaking with you soon.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
